items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. Week 5 was at Tennessee. No score is printed here because Sunday has not been played.

items.hed: Astros are out; Cleveland hosts Tampa Bay in Game 3 on Thursday
items.insight: MLB.com's postseason schedule lists the Dodgers, Brewers, Rays, and Guardians in the League Championship Series. Houston is not on that list. Milwaukee is at Los Angeles on Wednesday night at 8 p.m. Eastern. Tampa Bay at Cleveland, Game 3, moved to Thursday at 1 p.m. Eastern because of a forecast of inclement weather.

items.hed: Rockets host Oklahoma City on Thursday, then open against Dallas on Oct. 21
items.insight: The Rockets' game page lists Oklahoma City at Houston on Oct. 15 at Toyota Center. The club's schedule note says opening night, presented by Toyota, is against Dallas on Oct. 21 at Toyota Center. That note moved standard home tip times from 7 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. and does not print a tip for opening night, so none is stated here.
